Independently reproduced with a standalone Playwright probe (same Chromium binary, same CA pin, outside the harness) against both origins: visiting /minori-ai and /blog on A (www.growmax.io) also produces aborted first-party GET requests to /demo?_rsc=<token> and, on /blog, to /blog/<slug>?_rsc=<token> -- the identical Next.js client-side Link-prefetch-then-abort pattern, just with a different _rsc token (a per-render RSC content-negotiation cache key, not a stable build id: the standalone probe's own two blog visits produced the same token, coincidentally, which is why it wasn't caught by the P5.3 fix's search-string comparison; it is not guaranteed stable across renders). This is the same class of harness gap as the P5.2-attempt2 beacon false-positives (a per-render/per-session query value in an otherwise-symmetric first-party prefetch), now narrowed from 20/20 combinations to 2/20, and confirmed present on A too, not a Vercel-only regression.

facts.newFailedRequestsRootCause: harness: the P5.3 fix keys first-party requests on method+pathname+search+failure, but Next.js's own client-side Link prefetch appends a per-render `_rsc` cache-buster to the search string, so an aborted prefetch of the same route on A and B never matches on search even though the behavior (prefetch /demo, get cancelled, net::ERR_ABORTED) is identical on both sides; independently reproduced as present on A.

classNote: G5.4's literal gate text (visual pass or not_run with a reason; no new console errors) is satisfied: 20/20 pixel ratios <= 0.5%, 0 new console errors, 0 new HTTP error responses. The one remaining signal is SPEC-04 §7's broader 'new failed requests' extension, which the P5.3 fix improved (20/20 -> 2/20 false positives) but did not fully close: it still compares the RSC `_rsc` query token exactly for first-party prefetch requests, and that token is not guaranteed stable per render. Confirmed non-blocking and symmetric by independent reproduction outside the harness.
recommendation: Non-blocking for G5.4/G5. For a follow-up harness fix (lower priority than the P5.3 one): strip the `_rsc` query key specifically (like `dpl` was stripped for assetRefs) before computing the first-party key in normalizeFailedRequestKey, and add a self-test case for a prefetch abort with different `_rsc` tokens on A and B. Not required before G5, since no literal gate criterion depends on it and both remaining flags were independently confirmed present on A as well.
